module: Road template editor (Window > Roads > "Road Template Editor" menu). Lets you choose, save ("Save", "Save as..."), create ("New") and delete a road template (.road.json file) made of DecalRoads, decorations and decals; the fields are edited in the Inspector window. Depends on editor_roadEditor and relies on editor_roadUtils (template reloading). When the window is hidden, the current template is deselected and its temporary objects are deleted.
notes: Preference roadTemplates.general.loadTemplates (bool, default false): "Load road templates on startup (longer initialization time)". As long as it is false, editor_roadUtils neither reloads nor applies any template.

"Delete" deletes the file with os.remove("roadtemplates/<name>.road.json") (path relative to the process working directory, whereas saving and editor_roadUtils use levels/<level>/roadtemplates/: probable BUG, Delete does not delete the right file).

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame: if the "roadTemplateEditor" window is hidden, deselects the template; otherwise draws the "Road Templates" window with the buttons Choose Template, Save, Save as..., New, Delete and the choice of the template's roads/decorations/decals.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called when the editor initializes: adds the "Road Template Editor" menu entry (Roads group) and registers the window (200x400).

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Registers the "roadTemplates" preference category with the "general" subcategory and the loadTemplates checkbox (bool, false by default).
